$comment: Blind rater Y. Read only eval/RATING.md, docs/FUN_EVAL_IDLE.md, ../eval-fun/docs/FRAMEWORK.md sections 1-3 (read by printing up to section 4), eval/SCORECARD.template.json. Also opened tools/driver.mjs header and eval/score.sh (tooling only) and eval/presets.json idle-roguelike weights line. No PLAN.md, research/, docs/CUT*, other cards or source. Played headed on the GPU at 400x800 3x. Notes: scratchpad/raterY/notes.md; shots: scratchpad/raterY/shots/.

absences: simulated overnight via ?dev=1&absent=8h (taken after 36 min active, not 40; returned for ~18 min). No real-time absence; return scored same day, against the idle protocol's anti-bias advice.

criterion.delayedRecall: same-day: After the overnight my greedy heir kept banking at D8 because a goblin warlord walled D9 at 0%, so once a run taught me 'counter: attack boss' I wrote 'depth ≥ 8 · foes ≥ 1 → attack boss' and the forecast jumped D9 0% → 67% at the cost of 25% death. The first try slew the warlord and then died at 1 hp in the Fens to splitting pink jellies because my gas-retreat rule kept him dancing and bank said 'no way' down there, so I added 'hp < 25% → return' as a fallback. The next heir broke the warlord in five seconds, ground through the jellies with 'R2 drink heal saved him', and banked $215 at D10, my new best.

probes.clarity: Mostly yes: 'R3 ATTACK GOBLIN' over the fight and the D1–D8 shaft told me what the rules did; I was lost when the stall screen said 'Stalled: the jackal, no path' while its own trace showed my gas-retreat rule ping-ponging, and when a bought card silently pushed death 4% → 13%.
probes.decisions: Swapping 'return' for 'bank' (~$78 → ~$118) and adding 'attack boss' (D9 0% → 67%, death 4% → 25%) were choices I'd defend; the second I'd make again, the first was a free upgrade rather than a choice.
probes.mastery: I now order safety rows above 'attack nearest' (the offline death 't6970 R7 bank' then 't6980 R6 attack nearest' taught me) and know bank fails in the Fens.
probes.tension: I sweated carrying '$134 · keeps $0 · stalling' and the D9 push at 25% death; the warlord kill itself resolved in about one second of the watch.
probes.feel: The callouts land ('WARLORD BREAKS', 'GOBLIN WARLORD DOWN'), but foes stack on one tile, the warlord sprite hid my hero entirely, and the Fens were minutes of 'R8 · attack nearest / R5 · retreat'. Audio unassessed (could not hear; __audio not readable as a list in this build).
probes.surprise: Bloats that 'pop!', thieves and monkeys stealing my heal potion, finding 'heir 1's bones: 12 items', the warlord's 'shielded', and the Fens' splitting jellies each changed a rule; 'Krak the jackal, gone wild' and 'Vrim the goblin is avenged' repeated nearly every run.
probes.expression: My set — depth≥10 bank, heal, hp<25% bank, hp<25% return, gas retreat, attack boss, cleave, attack — reads as a cautious boss-hunting fighter, though it converged on what the shaft rewards.
probes.story: The reel line 'An archer took him to 1 HP; R6 attacked; died to goblin.' and the named killers who get 'avenged' by later heirs gave me anecdotes.
probes.pacing: Check-ins were 1–3 minutes and chosen; in-run, each cage parked the watch ~30 s while I read, and the Fens dragged at 1×.
probes.failure: The morgue line 'R6 depth not ≥5' ×4 while the rogue explored at 1 hp told me exactly which of my conditions killed him, '2 hp short'.
probes.social: None; named nemeses (Vrim, Morusk, Skim) are flavour, not relationships.
probes.autonomy: I chose to hunt the warlord and to push past the 'PLATEAU / R1 bank ended 4 runs, none past D8' line; nothing asked me to.
probes.progression: Within-run: L2→L4, 'verb · cleave', 'counter: attack boss'; between runs: rows 4→8, vault, supplies 3→5, rogue then ranger; automation: 'auto: restock' rebought 'heal ×30 · −$1200' overnight without me.
probes.aesthetic: The camp's painted stairwell and parchment sheets are handsome; the pixel dungeon is a tight, stacked close-up I would not sit in.
probes.return: I came back to '16 RUNS · 13 BANKED · 3 DEATHS · +$2168 home', a PLATEAU line naming my R1, and 'R7 fired 4 of 16 runs', and I decided to reorder R7 and raise R1 because of it; I did not wish I'd stayed.
probes.attribution: 'I put depth ≥ 5 on the bank rule, so he wandered at 1 hp' — my rule, my death; the only misattribution was the stall headline blaming the jackal.

axes.proxy: time-to-first-rule-edit; misread rate on the trace
axes.note: Shaft + callouts make goals legible ('R3 ATTACK GOBLIN'); but the stall headline 'Stalled: the jackal, no path' contradicted its trace (R2 retreat / · explore), the kite-archers card made death 4%→13% with no word, the report said 'RUNS 1 · DEATHS 0' after a stall, and the forecast lags a few seconds after edits.

'depth ≥ 8 · foes ≥ 1 → attack boss' moved D9 0% → 67% but death 4% → 25% — a real bank-or-push trade I made at check-in. Lapse: 'bank' strictly dominated 'return' (~$78 → ~$118, keeps 100%) and every card showed 'reach ~0', so part of the menu is dominated.

Deepest went D7 → D8 → D10 as I learned ordering ('t6970 R7 bank' preempted by 't6980 R6 attack nearest'), bank-over-return, and the boss counter; much of the lift came from the forecast telling me rather than me reading the dungeon.

Carried stakes were real ('$126 carried · keeps 0% · stalled', '$182 carried' lost in the Fens), but the peak ('GOBLIN WARLORD DOWN') resolved in ~1 s of the watch and most offline outcomes arrive as a ledger.

axes.proxy: frame time; events per minute at 1x
axes.note: Big callouts ('WARLORD BREAKS') are punchy, but monsters stack on one tile, the warlord sprite fully covered the hero, cages park the watch ~30 s, and the Fens were minutes of alternating 'R8 · attack nearest / R5 · retreat'. Audio unassessed.

axes.proxy: death-cause entropy; distinct situations per run
axes.note: Bloats ('it swells', 'pops!'), thieves stealing heals, 'Found heir 1's bones: 12 items', warlord 'shielded', Fens jellies 'splitter' each changed my rules; D1–D7 repeated (Krak on D3, 'Vrim the goblin is avenged' on D4, bloats on D6) nearly every run.

Eight rows I wrote ('hp < 25% → bank' then '→ return' for the Fens, 'adjacent ≥ 2 → cleave', 'attack boss') are recognisably mine, but the forecast steers everyone toward the same bank/heal/boss spine.

Reels like 'An archer took him to 1 HP; R6 attacked; died to goblin.' and the chronicle '♟2 the curious rogue · found ♟1's bones · fell to a goblin' carry turns; nemesis 'avenged' lines repeat every run and lose meaning.

axes.proxy: run length; check-in length; dead time at 1x
axes.note: Check-in 1–3 min, runs ~1–3 min in 'fights'; cages hold the run ~30 s each (≈90 s of one 5-min watch), 'fast' mode was slower than 'fights' (79 s, 'pick up ×35'), and the Fens dragged until I hit ▶▶|. Overnight vs 20-min absences not compared (one absence only).

axes.proxy: share of deaths with a matched-rule trace
axes.note: Death screen names cause, margin and rule: morgue 'slain by goblin · blow 2 · 2 hp short' with 'R6 depth not ≥5' each tick; patches with survive gauges; next heir starts at once. Lapse: the stall screen blamed 'the jackal, no path' and death 2's banner narrated the monkey's thefts instead of the gap.
I set my own goal (kill the warlord, pass the 'PLATEAU / R1 bank ended 4 runs, none past D8') and chose depth caps, class and trait freely; the dungeon itself is a fixed descent.

Rows 4→8, vault 1→2, supplies 3→5, rogue ('bank once') and ranger ('slay a boss'), L1→L4, new verbs 'cleave' and 'attack boss', automation 'auto: restock' ('SPENT heal ×30 · −$1200' overnight) and auto-keep. Lapse: ~12 'card:' unlocks each read 'reach ~0' and one made things worse.
Painted camp banner, parchment sheets, the torn red death banner with a wax 'GAP' seal are atmospheric; the in-run pixel view is cramped and cluttered. Audio unassessed.

axes.proxy: offline yield vs active; decisions pending on return
axes.note: Return screen: '16 RUNS · 13 BANKED · 3 DEATHS · +$2168 home', 'PLATEAU / R1 bank ended 4 runs, none past D8', 'R7 fired 4 of 16 runs', three deaths to open — I acted within a minute. Lapse: 13 of 16 offline runs were the same 'D8 · BANKED' line, and it was one simulated absence taken same day.

axes.proxy: share of deaths attributable to a rule the player wrote
axes.note: I tell the deaths in first person: 'my R6 had depth ≥ 5 so he wandered at 1 hp', 'my bank row sat below attack nearest', 'my gas rule looped him'. Lapse: the stall headline pinned it on a jackal, and the forecast did much of the deciding.
